## Which one is an integer? {.quiz-question .quiz-multiple}

- [2.5]{data-explanation="2.5 is a Floating Point number"}
- [3]{.correct}
- ['a']{data-explanation="'a' is a character"}
- [-2]{.correct}

::: footer
Click on the correct options then click the check button. If you got it wrong click reset and try again.
:::

## Which statement is true? {.quiz-question .quiz-multiple}

- [typeof() is a function]{.correct}
- [typeof() can be used to find out the data Type of a variable]{.correct}
- typeof() does not need an input argument
- typeof() can only be used with Integers and Floating point numbers

::: footer
Click on the correct options then click the check button. If you got it wrong click reset and try again.
:::

## Which statement is true? {.quiz-question .quiz-multiple}

- [sizeof() is a function]{.correct}
- [sizeof() can be used to find out the size of variable in bytes]{.correct}
- sizeof() can be used to find out the lenght of an element
- sizeof() needs an input argument{.correct}

::: footer
Click on the correct options then click the check button. If you got it wrong click reset and try again.
